title: Ten Nuts in Ten Cups
lines: Meg got ten nuts and ten cups.
"A nut can fit in a cup," said Meg.
Meg set the cups on the mats.
Ten cats got up and did tip the cups!
Nuts on the mats! Nuts in the pots!
"Do not bat the nuts," said Meg.
A cat did tip a nut in a cup.

questions.ask: Where did Meg set the cups?
questions.listenFor: On the mats. The story says it. If your child guesses, have them find the word mats and read that line again.

questions.ask: What did the cats do at the very end?
questions.listenFor: They tipped a nut back into a cup. Listen for the nut going back in - the cats put it right by accident.

questions.ask: Do you think the cats were helping Meg? Tell me why you think so.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason from the story, like they made the mess first, or they put a nut back.
